training_reference.scope: V5.8 bounded nominal recovery using verified pretrained ability and SCUT-style range progression only for repair tasks
training_reference.initialization_decision: Compare original 12486, V5.7 update 5000 and update 6500 on the same 27 cases before choosing the actor
training_reference.reward_definition: Restore original 12486 fixed narrow height kernel and quadratic; no group-dependent width/weight curriculum, wide companion or stationary-anchor addition
training_reference.optimization: Fixed 3e-5, fresh critic/optimizer, 49152 samples per minibatch; warmup and total budget scale by reference sample count
training_reference.schedule: One independently renewable recovery stage: 1000 updates at 8192 environments or 667 updates at 12288, no automatic launch of later stages
training_reference.rehearsal: Half of on-policy samples retain original nominal-height task ranges; retained groups bypass beginner caps and never regress
training_reference.progression: Repair groups score actual near-frontier steady commands, completed-horizon evidence and failures; at most one rollback per 750 reference updates
training_reference.regression: Report 18 retained, four learning and five observation cases separately; quantitative retention margins do not rewrite original pass/fail results
training_reference.checkpointing: Every boundary change is logged and sealed at the following PPO update boundary; scheduled 100-update snapshots remain
training_reference.recovery: Same-contract optimizer and version-3 curriculum resume only
training_reference.future_scope: Decide subsequent speed coverage, multi-height holds, height-motion combinations and contact/jump/terrain contracts after this stage's evidence
